criteria.evidence: Seeds the escaped edit or shifts the relevant comparison by one in a scratch copy, then reruns the same four tests.
criteria.reason: This directly measures whether the existing assertions detect the named fault.

criteria.evidence: Keeps the suite if it catches the fault. For a surviving mutant, compares the public parser results and adds a regression row only for a demonstrated gap. Stops after classification and verification or at ten minutes.
criteria.reason: The documented boundary result determines what to ship, and the cap covers triage.

criteria.evidence: Approves one manual run and checks the four focused tests on the original function before seeding the fault.
criteria.reason: The baseline serves this experiment alone and creates no ongoing repository requirement.

criteria.evidence: Temporarily reintroduces the escaped boundary comparison or shifts the relevant bound in a scratch copy, leaving the four tests unchanged for measurement.
criteria.reason: One seeded comparison tests the specified off-by-one fault at low cost.

criteria.evidence: Keeps the suite when the intended assertion fails. For a demonstrated gap, verifies the missing public boundary assertion against the mutant and the restored parser. Stops at a conclusive result or ten minutes.
criteria.reason: Detection and an observable gap lead to distinct test decisions, with an explicit time limit for an inconclusive run.

criteria.evidence: Approves the proposed one-off run and uses a temporary function-scoped comparison with the existing test command.
criteria.reason: The plan requires neither recurring administration nor a permanent score or gate.

criteria.evidence: Temporarily shifts the comparison at the relevant limit and runs the same four existing tests on the original and mutant.
criteria.reason: The single edit and unchanged assertions isolate the fault the maintainer asked about.

criteria.evidence: Ships no change if an existing boundary assertion fails as expected. If all four tests pass, keeps a new exact-boundary assertion only after it fails on the mutant and passes on the original. Stops after the one fault or at ten minutes.
criteria.reason: The specified public result determines whether to keep a regression, and unresolved evidence at the cap is recorded as inconclusive.

criteria.evidence: Runs one fault manually through the existing test runner and removes the temporary production edit.
criteria.reason: It accepts bounded mutation testing without adding a recurring lane, repository baseline, or permanent gate.
